leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a cost monitoring dashboard to visualize resource usage
Configure auto-scaling rules to adjust resources based on demand
Apply tagging strategies to categorize and track cloud expenditures
Construct budget alerts to notify when spending exceeds thresholds
Manipulate instance types and sizes to match workload requirements
Integrate reserved instance purchases to reduce long-term costs
Update storage policies to archive or delete unused data
